# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities **privately** — do not open a public
issue or discussion.

- Preferred: **[Report a vulnerability][advisory]** on this repository's
  Security tab (GitHub private vulnerability reporting).
- Or email **info@norconex.com** with `SECURITY` in the subject line.

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the most recent release. The v4 line is in beta; the v3
line (`3.x-branch`) receives fixes for significant issues until v4 is stable.

[advisory]: https://github.com/Norconex/crawler/security/advisories/new
